guitar.notes: Paul Kossoff is well documented as a classic Gibson Les Paul player (1959 Les Paul Standard), influential blues-rock tone.

tone.target: dry British hard-rock crunch with biting upper mids
tone.profile: dry British hard-rock crunch with biting upper mids
tone.summary: A vintage Marshall Plexi style chain, utilizing a Boost for initial punch, followed by a Distortion to achieve the core crunchy tone, paired with the UK 45 amp model and UK Vintage 4x12 cabinet. Minimal effects are used to maintain raw clarity.
